ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited Q1 FY26 Earnings Call**  Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL) reported strong Q1 FY26 operational performance as an independently listed entity post-demerger, achieving industry-leading retail like-to-like growth of 15% for Lifestyle Brands and 10% for Youth/Innerwear despite a sluggish market. Overall revenue grew 6% and PAT increased 5%, though the consolidated EBITDA margin slightly dipped to 15.5% primarily due to a strategic, elevated marketing spend (IPL sponsorship) which is expected to normalize, and the impact of the Forever 21 closure on emerging businesses. Management anticipates accelerated store expansion and improved profitability in H2 FY26, with Innerwear losses significantly reduced and targeting break-even by FY27.
